title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
summary: A strictly increasing array has been cyclically shifted.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–5,000 distinct values in [−5,000, 5,000]. The array comes from an increasing array by a cyclic shift.

statement: A strictly increasing array has been cyclically shifted. Return its smallest value using logarithmic time. A full-length shift leaves the array in increasing order.

examples.explanation: The increasing array starts with its minimum.
The smaller of the two entries is second.

constraints: 1–5,000 distinct values in [−5,000, 5,000]. The array comes from an increasing array by a cyclic shift.
hints: Conceptual: The smallest value is where the array wraps back to the low values.
Directional: Compare the midpoint with the rightmost remaining value to find which side contains the wrap.
Implementation: If the midpoint exceeds the right value, move left past it. Otherwise keep the midpoint as the new right bound.
complexityAnalysis: O(log n) time and O(1) auxiliary space. Each step retains only the half that can contain the minimum.
